routes.name: Dum, in Devanagari
routes.direction: Create a completely original DEVANAGARI/HINDI-first restaurant wordmark. Exact text 'दम ए' on first line and 'ओडिशा' on second. Preserve all letters and matras. Bold confident hand-painted Devanagari signwriting, a graceful headline/shirorekha treatment, a rising steam accent drawn in the clear space ABOVE the headline, never replacing a character or matra. Add small English exact 'DUM E ODISHA' below. Burnt vermilion #A43C2D and mustard #DBA13C on ivory #FFF6E7. Thick beautiful curves, elegant restaurant signage warmth, subtle brush rhythm. Avoid artificial Sanskrit calligraphy, sacred symbols, crowns and generic swashes.
